text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet worked hard every day toward her new goal:
to become "the horse girl with the most fun reactions."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, then horror is the only way—horror!
Even if I tend to put on a tough front...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: With scary stuff that I'm bad at, I'm sure I can give the number one reaction! I'm counting on you, Kitasan, Satono, Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to us, Scarlet-san!
So basically, we just have to startle you so hard you flip over, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
T-That's way too much! Keep it gentle, please.
That's why I gathered you younger girls in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just the right amount, then.
Understood♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go first! Since it's the beginning,
I'll start with something totally not scary, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet-san!
Actually... I'm a ghost!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh, a ghost?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, oh Kita-chan. There's no ghost out there that would go around claiming to be a ghost...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No way?! Y-You're not, right...? Kitasan,
your tail is still attached properly, right?! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well then, let us raise the scare factor a bit.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Look over there, Scarlet-san.
See, this shrine has an evil-warding talisman pasted on it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And now... I shall peel it off♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Peel it...?! I-I-If you do something like that...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. People say you will be cursed or haunted.
However...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It is mere superstition. We will know once we try.
Ready, set—
(*RIIIIIP!!*)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding♪ I merely tore a piece of paper I brought with me. Even if it is superstition, peeling off a real talisman would be improper.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Scarlet-san?
Whatever is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Looks like that was
a bit too intense for her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no more! Cancelled, cancelled, cancelled!
I don't care what anyone says, I'm going homeee!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aww, but Marvelous-san hadn't even gone yet...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, it is fine.
This was plenty of good practice...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wait? By the way, is this the right way back?
Somehow this doesn't look familiar at all...
(—*WHOOSH!*)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh?! What is this place?!
Forget looking familiar, the entire scenery is...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It is... bizarre... Could we have wandered into some kind of sacred spiritual realm deep in the mountains?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! So super Marvelous★
Blinky-blink go the eyes in the night sky~! Fuzzy-wuzzy reach the hands from the ground~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Who? Who am I?
Squishy-squashy, Marvelous★△※♪
MAAAARRRVELLOUUUS☆

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
GYAAAAAAAHHH!?!?
Uwah... ah... ah... bweeehh...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, Scarlet-san, hang in there...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Scarlet-san said she wanted to give great reactions, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: She had the best expressions of anyone today, right? If she can make faces like that, she should be totally fine, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous☆

Daiwa Scarlet mastered the greatest reactions.
Afterward, she apparently made it back to the mortal world through the power (?) of Marvelous Sunday.
